head: 9f1c2d3e4b5a60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d
summary: Two findings cite source locations that are not part of the reviewed head: one line the diff never touched, and one path outside the checkout.

findings.claim: The accumulator is never returned on the success path.
findings.evidence: Cited at a line the reviewed diff does not contain.
findings.requirement: Acceptance criterion: 'Validation rejects ... an out-of-range source location'.
findings.verification: Validate this payload against the reviewed diff.

findings.claim: Credentials are read from outside the checkout.
findings.evidence: Cited at a path that escapes the repository root.
findings.requirement: A source location must name a path inside the reviewed head.
findings.verification: Validate this payload and assert the escaping path is rejected.

findings.claim: The end of the cited range precedes its start.
findings.requirement: A source range must end at or after it starts.
findings.verification: Validate this payload and assert the inverted range is rejected.
